SELECT * from ( SELECT u.*, 0 as bind_type, u.username as bind_target, d.name as dept_name FROM data_role r join users_data_roles ur on r.data_role_type = 0 and ur.data_role_id=#{id} and ur.data_role_id = r.id join `user` u on ur.user_id = u.id and u.`status`=1 join dept d on u.dept_id = d.id where 1=1
and (u.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or u.username like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or d.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%'))
union ALL SELECT u.*, 1 as bind_type, d.name as bind_target, d.name as dept_name FROM depts_data_roles dr join dept d on dr.data_role_id=#{id} and dr.dept_id=d.id join `user` u on u.dept_id = d.id and u.`status`=1 where 1=1
and (u.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or u.username like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or d.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%'))
union ALL SELECT u.*, 2 as bind_type, g.group_name as bind_target, d.name as dept_name from groups_data_roles gr join `group` g on gr.data_role_id=#{id} and gr.group_id=g.id join groups_users gu on g.id = gu.group_id join `user` u on gu.user_id = u.id join dept d on u.dept_id = d.id where 1=1
and (u.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or u.username like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or d.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%'))
)a order by a.created_time desc

and (u.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or u.username like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or d.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%'))

select * from data_role
where id like concat('%',#{keyWords},'%') or created_user like concat('%',#{keyWords},'%') or name like concat('%',#{keyWords},'%')

select count(1) from data_role
where id like concat('%',#{keyWords},'%') or created_user like concat('%',#{keyWords},'%') or name like concat('%',#{keyWords},'%')

select * from data_roles_permission where data_role_id=#{dataRoleId}
and database_name like concat('%',#{keyWords},'%') or table_name like concat('%',#{keyWords},'%')

select count(1) from data_roles_permission where data_role_id=#{dataRoleId}
and database_name like concat('%',#{keyWords},'%') or table_name like concat('%',#{keyWords},'%')

select dr.id, dr.name, dr.remark, dr.`status`, dr.created_time, dr.created_user, dr.modify_user, dr.modify_time, ddr.dept_id from depts_data_roles ddr join data_role dr on dr.data_role_type = 0 and ddr.data_role_id = dr.id where ddr.dept_id = #{deptId}
select dr.* from groups_data_roles gr join data_role dr on dr.data_role_type = 0 and gr.group_id=#{groupId} and dr.status = 1 and gr.data_role_id = dr.id

select dr.*, ar.approve_status from ( select dr.* from data_role dr where dr.id = #{id} )dr left join( select approve_target_id, approve_status from approve_record where id= ( select max(id) as id from approve_record ar where ar.flow_tag = 'upcDataRole' and approve_target_id = #{id} ) )ar on dr.id = ar.approve_target_id
